usage: deskops add inbox-note [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                              --kind {unclear,suggestion}
                              [--sender-project SENDER_PROJECT]
                              [--target-project TARGET_PROJECT]
                              --created-at CREATED_AT --status {open,closed}
                              [--acknowledged-by ACKNOWLEDGED_BY]
                              [--acknowledged-at ACKNOWLEDGED_AT]
                              [--title TITLE] --body BODY

Create a inbox-note artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the inbox-note payload from a YAML file.
  --kind {unclear,suggestion}
                        Inbox note type indicating unresolved confusion or an improvement proposal.
  --sender-project SENDER_PROJECT
                        Project that sent the inbox message, resolved from the repo registry when possible.
  --target-project TARGET_PROJECT
                        Project the inbox note targets, resolved from the shared desk identity contract.
  --created-at CREATED_AT
                        Timestamp for when the inbox note was created.
  --status {open,closed}
                        Whether the inbox note is still open or already handled.
  --acknowledged-by ACKNOWLEDGED_BY
                        Project identity that acknowledged and closed the inbox note.
  --acknowledged-at ACKNOWLEDGED_AT
                        Timestamp for when the inbox note was acknowledged and closed.
  --title TITLE         Inbox note title shown as the H1 heading.
  --body BODY           Markdown body describing the question or suggestion in detail.

Example:
  deskops add inbox-note --root . --title "Example"
